labs.name: Unpriced Stock Lab
labs.question: Which of about a thousand US stocks will do better than the others over the next five trading days?

labs.name: Unpriced Risk Lab
labs.question: How much will the market and each sector move over the next five trading days, and how likely is a fall of more than 3%?
labs.note: Connected to the Hub at 10:41 am ET on Nov 5, 2026, after that day's open, so its first two forecasts arrived late.

rules: On time means the Hub had its copy before the market opened. Anything it first sees after the open is kept but marked late, and never counts.
Each kind of forecast is graded by the measure that fits it, using prices the Hub downloads itself.
The labs answer different questions, so they are never ranked against each other.
The Hub only keeps score. It never chooses which models a lab uses.
